method: Independent Cartesian JSON-stat decoding; every numeric, missing and flag cell compared. Long-table pandas groupby recalculates all overall, category, residence and annual coverage measures. No collection module imported.
manual_semantics: The measure is resident population on 1 January by country of birth, not nationality or annual journeys.
The origin catalogue mixes individual countries/territories, overlapping aggregate groups, historical entities and old NUTS areas; they stay separate.
Original Eurostat EL/UK and other geography labels remain unchanged. No ISO or sovereignty harmonization is silently performed.
Own-country birth rows are marked non-cross-border; NAT is reporter-relative and is not invented as another country code.
Current revised history is not a vintage database proving what was known at an old forecast origin.
limitations: DE has zero individual-origin observations in the selected slice, not a zero foreign-born population.
ES and FR have sparse/changing individual-origin coverage; latest aggregate totals must not fill missing bilateral cells.
Country-level stocks cannot allocate passengers to city pairs without additional geography and a tested trip-frequency relationship.
The collected panel does not estimate the diaspora coefficient or resolve causal travel demand.
